name: Baker Hedda
title: The Bakehouse
examine: Awake when the city sleeps, asleep when it eats what she made. Her forearms could win the arm-wrestling table at the Delvers' Rest, and once, famously, did.
lines: The ovens never cool. Neither do I, more's the pity.
Night belongs to me and the watch and nobody else. You learn things about a city, being the only lit window in it.
First bell, first bread. The castle eats fourth, whatever Ansgar tells you — the miners are walking to a shift, the King is walking to a chair.
